newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela foreign reserves rise to $14.055 bln.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela foreign reserves rise to $14.055 bln.

text.p: Venezuela's foreign reserves rose $220 million, or 1.6 percent, to $14.055 billion in the week to October 28, according to figures released by the Central Bank.
Reserves were up from $13.835 on October 21, the bank's weekly bulletin of indicators showed.
Since the beginning of the year, reserves have risen $4.332 billion, overshooting the government's target.
Government officials said they expected foreign reserves to grow by only $1.5 billion in 1996 as part of Venezuela's IMF- supported economic adjustment program.
Venezuela's foreign reserve fell $1.784 billion, or 15.5 percent, in 1995 to end the year at $9.723 billion.
